name: dashboard_cards
title: Asked for dashboard cards, Alpha proposes a few that fit the table and keeps nothing before the yes

steps.say: Propose dashboard cards for the Deals table (deals).
steps.reply:
I've proposed four dashboard cards for Deals. They're kept only if you say yes.

- **Total deal value:** the sum of all amounts, so you see how big the pipeline and past wins are.
- **Deals by stage:** a count of leads, open, won and lost deals, to show where things sit.
- **Value closing over time:** amounts by close date, so you can plan when money is expected.
- **Deals needing attention:** open or lead deals whose close date has passed or is near.

The table has only 4 deals so far, so the cards will be sparse until you add more.

checks.why: 1 proposed entry: Dashboard cards for Deals: Total deal value; Deals by stage; Value closing over time; Deals needing attention.

checks.why: The answer says it proposed four dashboard cards, names each one, and states they are kept only if the person says yes, so it does not claim a dashboard is already set up.
